title: Translation change of variables for indicator differences tested against an integrable function
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let F ⊆ ℝ^N be L^N-null-measurable with real indicator 1_F, let ψ : ℝ^N → ℝ be Lebesgue integrable, and let h ∈ ℝ^N. Then ∫_{ℝ^N} (1_F(y + h) − 1_F(y))·ψ(y) dy = ∫_F (ψ(z − h) − ψ(z)) dz.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn N → ℝ) (h : Rn N), NullMeasurableSet F volume → Integrable ψ volume → ∫ y, (F.indicator (1 : Rn N → ℝ) (y + h) - F.indicator (1 : Rn N → ℝ) y) * ψ y = ∫ z in F, (ψ (z - h) - ψ z)
